percent_meaning: Subjective research progress, not independent Lean proof coverage, probability, or permission to promote manuscript status; status promotions require exact-head full kernel and axiom audit.

targets.title: Original polynomial-time writers
targets.evidence: Kernel-verified at the original scope. For every polynomial p, machine M and input, the actual machines windowMTM p and inputMTM M p write originalWindowCode p x and originalInputCode M p x at their first halt within explicit polynomial transition bounds (windowMTM_outputs, inputMTM_outputs). Hence originalWindowCode_fp, originalInputCode_fp, the unconditional originalWM, originalWM_first_answer (T_W = 2 T_M), originalWM_decides and P_Turing_subset_P_disc_by_original. Gate scripts/verify_ii10_original_wm.sh passed on commit df8824c: Lean 4.23.0, lake build PVNP 7,386 jobs, 627 audited declarations with standard axioms only, 24 Python regression tests.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original claim. GitHub-hosted CI has not executed for this head (issue #59); the kernel evidence is the local exact-head gate.

targets.title: Uniform separator theorem
targets.evidence: Refuted for the frozen physical trajectory class. SeparatorFrozen.no_uniform_separator_price: on the torus of side L, the exact plane-wave solutions of fixed amplitude A have curvature functional at most 4π²|A|² + 16π⁴c²|A|²/L² (any curvature operator dominated by c|Δψ|, including Δ and the Part III Θ_ε), while the Euclidean length of the frontier of the decision region {Re ψ > 0} is at least L, at every time. These fields are used by an admissible decider (stripe_device_decides); the modulus readout fails the same way (no_uniform_price_modulus). Corrected statement: layer_price (sharp width-dependent price 4η²/w).
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original hypothesis. A uniform price needs an extra hypothesis bounding transition widths (sharp interfaces), under which SeparatorPrice.mesh_price and SeparatorFrozen.layer_price apply.

targets.title: General toroidal locking
targets.evidence: SpatialLocking.sat_iff_locked (PR #95): on the spatial torus T_L² of the frozen equation, a multi-component frozen-WCT field with |ψᵢ| = 1 everywhere, zero local sign-blind clause/coupling/curvature density of the relative field ψ_{i+1}·conj ψ₀ and zero gradient energy exists iff the formula is satisfiable, for every formula, L > 0 and λ, μ ≥ 0. Locks are exact curvature-free solutions of the frozen flow (frozen_flow_preserves_locks), and for κ ≤ 0, β ≤ 0 < γ no frozen trajectory approaches one from outside (no_attracting_locks). InterwovenSAT.locks_iff_sat_iff characterizes the flux energies for which the equivalence holds; sign-sensitive coupling, which does not correspond to clause satisfaction, fails (naive_toroidal_locking_fails).
targets.remaining_obligation: None mathematical. Reaching a lock is not part of the claim: the frozen flow never approaches one from outside, and energy descent from formula-independent preparations is trapped by false wells (I-3). "ψ–electron" is undefined in the manuscript and is read as the reference component.

targets.title: Encoding-independent interface theorem
targets.evidence: ExpanderInterface.expanderGrowth_SAT_iff: in the charged constant-device class the hypothesis for dense SAT is equivalent to P_TM ≠ NP_TM; WCTSATScaling.superpoly_SAT_implies_P_ne_NP (PR #90): any superpolynomial physical-resource lower bound for SAT over a class containing the charged zero-mode torus devices implies P_TM ≠ NP_TM. False for every language in P_TM. PR #95: for dense SAT in the charged constant class it is equivalent to the NP-verified reading of I-2 and to I-16 (NonconstructibleFamily.npFamily_iff_expanderGrowth). Its manuscript use needs lem:separator-price (I-31), which is refuted for the frozen class.
targets.remaining_obligation: Cannot be proved without proving P_TM ≠ NP_TM; in the constant-device class it cannot be refuted without P_TM = NP_TM.

targets.title: Physical SAT dynamics and readout
targets.evidence: Static criterion in the sign-blind interwoven encoding: SAT ⟺ ground energy 0, UNSAT ⟺ ground energy ≥ 1/8, and the sign readout below 1/8 satisfies F (InterwovenSAT, PR #90); the 2^n corner sweep decides SAT for every formula (SATDynamics.sat_iff_corner_sweep, PR #95). Refuted as a dynamical test: the bare lock does not detect SAT; the sign-sensitive gradient fails; the PR #94 false well traps every energy-nonincreasing evolution of unit fields (SATDynamics.energy_monotone_trapped), so every formula-independent corner preparation fails on a satisfiable formula (no_corner_preparation_decides).
targets.remaining_obligation: Only non-monotone dynamics from formula-dependent polynomial-time preparations remain; with polynomial resources and a resource-preserving simulation any such SAT decider gives P_TM = NP_TM (efficient_device_and_simulation_imply_P_eq_NP), so this is the P versus NP question, not a separate obligation of the criterion.

targets.title: Continuum physical-computation equivalence
targets.evidence: P_disc = P_TM exactly in the uniform discrete model; PhysicalAudit.unrestricted_phys_ne_P_TM for arbitrary encoders. PR #90: physical lower bounds transfer to classical ones without simulation in any class containing the charged zero-mode devices. PR #95: that class decides exactly P_TM (ContinuumPrecision.zeroDev_languages_eq_P_TM); the detector is Lipschitz on bounded sets and data precision δ with log(1/δ) = LF·T + log(4RC_χ/m) fixes a margin-m readout decision (precision_suffices); an approximate trajectory with residual ε stays within a Gronwall bound of the solution and fixes the readout (approx_readout).
targets.remaining_obligation: A polynomial-time finite-dimensional scheme for the nonlinear frozen evolution with a certified residual in the detector's norm (truncation of the solution, time discretization, arithmetic cost); by approx_readout nothing else is needed. Needs propagation of higher regularity, not proved.

targets.title: Nonconstructible wavefield family
targets.evidence: PR #95 (NonconstructibleFamily): explicit states — false (DepthBarrier.explicit_no_separation); input-indexed families with unrestricted verification — vacuously true via a diagonal language (unrestricted_family_separation); NP-verified families and physical wavefield families prepared by charged zero-mode torus devices — NPst \ Pst ≠ ∅ iff P_TM ≠ NP_TM (npFamily_separation_iff, wavefield_separation_iff), equivalent to I-16 for dense SAT (npFamily_iff_wccDepth).
targets.remaining_obligation: Every non-vacuous reading is exactly P_TM ≠ NP_TM; that separation is not proved.

targets.title: Universal SAT lower bound
targets.evidence: DepthBarrier.wccDepth_SAT_iff, wccdDepth_SAT_iff, uniform_depth_SAT_iff: for dense SAT the conjecture is exactly P_TM ≠ NP_TM. WCTSATScaling.zeroSuperpoly_SAT_iff (PR #90): the same for the charged zero-mode devices of the frozen torus model. PR #95: equivalent to the NP-verified reading of I-2 (NonconstructibleFamily.npFamily_iff_wccDepth). The strongest unconditional bound here is quadratic for one-tape deciders (CrossingSATMatrix.quadratic_every_budget).
targets.remaining_obligation: This is the classical P versus NP question; it is not resolved here, and finite data cannot establish it.

targets.title: Mathematical interpretation and classification
targets.evidence: The §8 remark states that no equivalence P^phys = NP^phys ⟺ retrocausality is proved and keeps the section as a research direction; it asserts no theorem and is classified Interpretive (13 November 2026). Torus.backward_eq_forward_conj and flow_neg give the exact frozen-model form of its sentence on inverse dynamics, as supporting material.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the interpretive entry. Any future theorem about time reversal and complexity needs its own model, quantifiers and claim identifier.
